title: Reverse String
description: Given a string, return the string with its characters in reverse order.
input_format: A single line containing the string.

examples.explanation: The characters of hello are reversed to produce olleh.
The characters of world are reversed to produce dlrow.

hints: You can build the result from the end of the string.
Try using two pointers starting at opposite ends.
Swap characters while the left pointer is smaller than the right pointer.
editorial: Use two pointers, one at the beginning and one at the end. Swap the characters at those positions and move both pointers toward the center.
